title: Shiro Shiro no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + Big Father as the peak (no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Castle-Castle Fruit: the user's body becomes a living fortress
His crew shrinks and hides inside his body; gun ports and cannons fire from it; he can imprison people inside
Big Father: a giant armed fortress-warrior form
Damage to the fortress walls hurts him directly
User: Capone "Gang" Bege; helped the Straw Hats escape Big Mom (Whole Cake Island)

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in stone grey stands in (no face or limbs).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a marine grunt in a white sailor cap and uniform.
**Capone Bege:** slicked-back black hair, moustache, cigar, dark pinstripe suit with a white cravat. Send a reference to match him exactly.
**Fortress body:** stone texture, little windows, gates and cannon ports on the host.
plan.sets: medieval town, lavender rays, castle gate, drawbridge over a moat, castle battlements, gangster office, smoky battlefield, dungeon with torches, candy-island coast, cracked stone wall, sick bay, stormy escape at sea, apartment hallway with a FOR RENT sign.
